data.action: 在硝烟与碎石中贴地滑铲突进，手持卡宾狙击枪射击，恶魔翅膀展开
data.description: 【银镜伊织 · 突击队长的破晓突进】硝烟弥漫的废墟走廊内，砖石碎屑在空中飞扬。伊织在爆破烟雾中完成凌空滑铲突进，修长矫健的双腿在黑丝包裹下划出凌厉的弧线，枪口火光瞬间照亮了她倔强而充满战意的小脸——「第一突击点突破！跟紧我，不要拖后腿！」
data.lighting: 枪口火光与晨曦穿透硝烟的强体积光
data.location: 废弃学园战术据点走廊
data.promptProse: Iori slides forward through the blasted ruined corridor, keeping her rifle ready amid flying brick fragments. Her assault jacket and tactical harness remain centered in the dynamic Dutch-angle cowboy view, with shattered openings leading behind through smoke. Muzzle flash briefly lights her determined face and gloves; dawn enters from the breach beyond, outlining debris and casting long broken-wall shadows across the path of her advance.
data.title: 银镜伊织 · 突击队长的破晓突进
